description: Allegheny County Addressing Street Centerlines is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Allegheny County. This dataset contains street centerlines for vehicular and foot traffic in Allegheny County. Street Centerlines are classified as Primary Road, Secondary Road, Unpaved Road, Limited Access Road, Connecting Road, Jeep Trail, Walkway, Stairway, Alleyway and Unknown. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Allegheny County. Its tags are PASDA, _etl, address, addressing, allegheny county. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, HTML, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
